blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Clear the inline outage latch before returning an answered allow (apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/inline-agent-loop-tools.ts:422): The successful-allow return occurs before `observeJudgeAvailabilityForRequest`.

[P1] Complete S6 with the required uncovered-read and scheduled-job cases (apps/core/test/unit/runtime/askfloor-tap-budget.test.ts:324): The purported uncovered-read case invokes `mcp__crm__update_record`, so it does not prove that an uncovered read asks at most once while the judge is offline.

[P1] Implement the full invariance matrix instead of label-only stand-ins (apps/core/test/unit/runtime/askfloor-invariance.test.ts:32): This suite does not exercise the required AF-AC6 matrix: the supposed projection quartet is one ordinary host-job request with no projected memory records, the supposed inline-scheduled case calls the IPC replay harness, and scheduler/admin/destructive/family-rail cases are collapsed into one command.

[P1] Run all TB fixtures and mirrors in the aggregation test (apps/core/test/unit/runtime/askfloor-tap-budget.test.ts:356): The aggregation case claims to execute TB1–TB4 and their mirrors, but it constructs only isolated browser/file examples in different lanes and never runs the complete four interactive-auto fixtures or the protected-write, outside-workspace-write, scheduler-delete, and raw-path-attach mirrors.

ASKFLOOR-1-T6-AC3: INLINE PATH. Same contract inside the `beforePrompt` callback of the inline consult (`deps.sendMessage(run.chatJid, NOTICE, { threadId: run.threadId })`), reason line on the inline ask, the inline guard (`:372`) yields `wiring_missing` only for an eligible lane, and the scheduled-job return at `:410` is preceded by the notice with the offline reason on the cancel decision. Tests: `inline-agent-loop-tools.test.ts` — the same cases plus the scheduled-job notice + reason.

ASKFLOOR-1-T6-AC4: NO TAP STORM, MEMORY STILL WRITES. With the judge offline: a deterministic read-only request inside a trusted root costs 0 taps and no notice (the read-only gate short-circuits before the LLM path); an uncovered read asks at most once per request; [Allow] with remember still writes the row and the identical repeat costs 0 taps offline (S4's shape, `source: 'human_decision'`); scheduled jobs keep deterministic denial + card recovery. Tests: S6 in `askfloor-tap-budget.test.ts` through the harness knobs of ruling 7.

ASKFLOOR-1-T6-AC5: INVARIANCE. NEW `askfloor-invariance.test.ts` proves every lane in AF-AC6 (ask, auto_strict, trusted-host autonomous incl. the projection quartet, YOLO backstop, unmapped-forced-ask, scheduler/admin/destructive, family rail hit, inline-scheduled, attachment_open birthright) yields exactly today's tuple under an answering judge AND under an `Unavailable` judge for each of the six codes + `wiring_missing` (the offline column differs only where AF-AC5 and 0157 say: interactive auto asks with the reason line; a job lane reaches its card with the reason line; everything else identical). Test titles are the required leaf ids verbatim.

ASKFLOOR-1-T6-AC6: AGGREGATION + GATES. The AF-AC8 aggregation run executes S1–S6 + TB1–TB4 + mirrors in one `it` and reports the tap total per lane (no earlier-owned test edited). Existing unit and Postgres suites pass; tsc and check:architecture green; ceilings: `ipc-permission-classifier-decision.ts` ≤ 700, `inline-agent-loop-tools.ts` ≤ 750, `permission-classifier.ts` ≤ 700, `ipc-interaction-processing.ts` ≤ 865 (untouched), 700 elsewhere; no wrapper, shim, alias or compatibility naming.
